name: Hooghly Valley Heart & Multispeciality Hospital
description: Eastern India's referral centre for heart, brain and cancer care, well known to patients from Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan. Bengali-speaking case managers handle visas, pickups and affordable stays near the hospital.

inclusions: Surgeon, anaesthetist and procedure fees
Operation theatre charges and standard consumables
One-night stay in a private room
Nursing care and routine medicines during the stay
Single-use dialyser and dialysis consumables
Routine dialysis blood tests
Pre-procedure tests listed in the treatment plan
Review consultation before you fly home
exclusions: International airfare and visa fees
Treatment of unrelated or pre-existing conditions
Extended ICU stay or care for complications beyond the plan
Accommodation outside the hospital (see the Medical + Stay package)
Erythropoietin and iron injections

reviews.title: Good care for my father's angioplasty
reviews.body: We came from Dhaka for my father's angioplasty. The Bengali-speaking coordinator helped with everything; the only issue was a long wait at billing on discharge day.
